event_name: Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team Document 40 Date 20 March 2022 Time 19:04 2022 BAHRAIN GRAND PRIX 18 - 20 March 2022 The Stewards The Stewards, having received a report from the Race Director, have considered the following matter and determine the following
fact: Alleged forcing another driver off the track in turn 4.
offence: Alleged breach of Appendix L Chapter IV 2 of the FIA International Sporting Code.
reason: The Stewards reviewed the video evidence and determined that STR was overtaking NOR to the inside of turn 6. STR was fully alongside, with the nose slightly ahead of the apex, and the driver remained in control of the car. Therefore the Stewards determine that no further action is appropriate.
stewards: in accordance with Article 15 of the FIA International Sporting Code
team: Aston Martin Aramco Cognizant F1 Team
title: Decision Car 18 Alleged Forcing Another Driver Off The Track
